Details showed Unpacked extension loaded from /Volumes/Samsung2TB/code/matrx-extend/.output/chrome-mv3-dev, matching the build receipt. The calendar was refreshed and Showcase reopened afterward.

cases.evidence: Doctor on the refreshed live calendar showed a repeating-card recommendation for the current page. Following it opened List Pattern with root #wideeventsList and item div.wideeventwrapper already filled. The recommendation text described 249 cards at this run; this count was observed from the current page, not taken from the previous run.

From that seeded builder, Pick more fields opened an overlay that reported 249 matching items. Clicking the first current event title staged DJ Pauly D; clicking its date staged SEP 27. Done returned to the builder with root #wideeventsList and item div.wideeventwrapper unchanged. The title field preview matched DJ Pauly D. I changed the two field names to title and url and set the url field selector to the same relative event-title anchor with Attribute href. The URL preview became https://electronic.vegas/event/dj-pauly-d-omnia-dayclub-vegas-sep-27/. The scope stayed on the original event cards.

Extract after the title/url configuration returned 249 rows. The UI table showed distinct current event titles paired with event-specific URLs. Sample pairs matched the current page: DJ Pauly D → https://electronic.vegas/event/dj-pauly-d-omnia-dayclub-vegas-sep-27/; DJ Sourmilk → https://electronic.vegas/event/dj-sourmilk-tao-beach-vegas-sep-27/; DJ Stretch → https://electronic.vegas/event/dj-stretch-palm-tree-beach-club-vegas-sep-27/; Al Tamar → https://electronic.vegas/event/al-tamar-marquee-dayclub-vegas-sep-27/; D-Miles → https://electronic.vegas/event/d-miles-marquee-dayclub-vegas-sep-28/. The table explicitly displayed 'Showing first 200 of 249 rows — Copy and Save include all of them'; I could not inspect all 249 output records in the visible table. The verified result is a successful title+URL extraction with correct sampled distinct records, not a full-row audit.

After builder Restart cleared the prior seeded draft, a fresh Pick an example item flow clicked the current DJ Pauly D title. The overlay explicitly said 'Several groups repeat here. Choose which group you want to extract.' It offered 3 nested li details, 249 div.wideeventwrapper event cards under #wideeventsList, and 2 larger section cards. Choosing the 249-card option produced '249 matching items selected' and the builder showed root #wideeventsList / item div.wideeventwrapper. This is explicit user choice of the intended event-card collection.

After choosing the 249-card scope and staging a title, the page picker Restart returned to 'Click one example item'. Cancel closed the overlay. The builder retained the explicitly chosen #wideeventsList / div.wideeventwrapper scope, had no selected fields, and Extract remained disabled. No rows or fields from the abandoned field-picking step were shown. The labels do not promise that Cancel rolls back a scope already deliberately selected, so this is recorded as an observation rather than a failure.
After navigating to https://example.com/, the Showcase host changed to example.com and List Pattern returned to Pick an example item with no event root, selected fields, or result rows.

data_changes.notes: No Save pattern action or other data write was used. Existing saved Microdata pattern was not run, edited, or deleted.

method: Direct native Chrome accessibility-tree and screenshot observation through CUA. No localhost, test server, fixture site, shell browser control, or hidden application state was used.
limitations: Only the first 200 of 249 extracted rows are displayed in the product table, and the complete 249-row collection was not independently inspected value by value.
No saved List Pattern recipe was written or reopened, so save/replay acceptance remains outside this bounded D43/D39 run.

The selected title and URL were previewed and extracted for distinct records. The second raw picker click initially selected the event date; I then used the visible field editor to set the URL field's href attribute. This does not establish automatic URL-field classification from clicking a link.
The Cancel observation followed a user choice of the correct 249-card scope. It did not leave a wrong collection or enabled extraction; rollback semantics are not promised by the overlay labels.
ui_stop: Sent UI_STOP to root after leaving Chrome on example.com with an empty List Pattern builder. Ctrl-C to the browser permit returned RESOURCE_BROWSER_STOP_CONFIRMED with resourceInvalid false and exit code 0.
